comingLast.roast: in on 24 - if he starts stretching near the door, tackle him
at 1.2 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
8 points buys freedom - Carberry is pricing it higher by the minute
on 11 - the only man on the course playing match play against the bottom of the list
averaging 1.4 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
on 17 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
on 21 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
current run rate 1.4 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
1 holes for a jailbreak - 1 point cuts the wire
in with a 1-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
